title: RecoveryOS — Control Tower (TRD §10)
description: Panels map 1:1 to the Control Tower UI (PRD §44). The top row of four stat tiles reads *_reconciled gauges, recomputed live from recovery_ledger/recoveries on every scrape (Production Architecture Domain Audit finding #1) -- genuinely 'no separate internal truth vs customer-facing truth', not just a claim: these are the same durable rows /v1/risk/summary itself queries, immune to any background worker's in-process counters resetting on restart. The panels below use TRD §10's raw Counters/Histogram, which are the right tool for rate/trend/activity panels.

panels.title: Revenue at Risk
panels.description: Control Tower: "Revenue at Risk" tile. revenue_at_risk_paise_reconciled -- recomputed live from recovery_ledger on every /metrics scrape (Production Architecture Domain Audit finding #1), not the raw revenue_at_risk_paise_total Counter, which resets to 0 on any worker restart with no reconciliation against the durable ledger.

panels.title: Recovered
panels.description: Control Tower: "Recovered" tile. revenue_recovered_paise_reconciled -- see panel 1's note; recomputed live from recovery_ledger, immune to worker restarts.

panels.title: Incremental Recovery
panels.description: Control Tower: "Incremental Recovery" tile. incremental_revenue_paise_reconciled -- recomputed live from recovery_ledger (see panel 1's note), not the raw incremental_revenue_paise_total accumulator.

panels.title: Recovery Rate
panels.description: Control Tower: "Recovery Rate" tile. recovery_success_reconciled / recovery_attempts_reconciled -- recomputed live from the `recoveries` table on every scrape (same restart-immunity reasoning as panels 1-3; the raw recovery_success_total/recovery_attempts_total Counters have the identical worker-restart vulnerability F1 identified for revenue).

panels.title: System Health — Bank Health Grid
panels.description: Control Tower: "System Health" bank grid. Count of systemic_degradation_events_total{bank} -- a bank with any recent count here is the same bank apps/api/routers/risk.py's bank_health marks DEGRADED (fresh, is_anomaly=true, severity=high window).

panels.title: Recovery Queue Activity — Attempts by Action Type
panels.description: Control Tower: "Recovery Queue" panel. Live rate(recovery_attempts_total[5m]) by action_type is the closest real-time proxy for queue throughput -- the queue itself is transient DB state (scheduled_reevaluations/recoveries with no terminal outcome), not a cumulative series, so this shows how fast the queue is being WORKED, not its current depth.

panels.title: Policy Blocks by Rule
panels.description: policy_blocks_total{rule} -- which specific policy_engine rule most often blocks/escalates a decision.

panels.title: Stopping Rule Triggers by Reason
panels.description: stopping_rule_triggers_total{reason} -- MAX_RETRIES vs STOP_AFTER_SUCCESS, from recoveries.stopping_rule_triggered (workers/execution_worker.py's _compute_stopping_rule).

panels.title: AI Diagnoser Fallback Rate
panels.description: ai_diagnoser_fallback_total / diagnosis_latency_seconds_count -- an honest reliability signal for how often the LLM path degrades to the deterministic fallback.

panels.title: Diagnosis Latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: diagnosis_latency_seconds histogram -- wall-clock time of diagnose() (diagnoser_role read -> investigation/LLM/fallback), per services/diagnosis_engine/diagnoser.py.
